milestones.desc: EXTENDED per addendum (reported by Jeff 08/10; VERIFY fully signed by both parties - unsigned means original 08/10 deadline stood): Seller response to Defect Notice due Wed 08/12 EOD. Silence = deemed agreement to all requested repairs.
If seller counters on 08/12: 2-day Settlement Period ends ~Fri 08/14; no mutual signed agreement = contract auto-terminates.
Buyer conditional loan approval due (~21 days from acceptance). Confirm with Amy.
Target: all agreed repairs complete + receipts (window compressed by extension: agreement ~08/12 -> ~12 days to complete before re-inspection).
Lender clear-to-close due (3 days before closing per contract 4(d)).
Buyer re-inspection of completed repairs (3 days prior to closing per Defect Notice); provide work orders, warranties, receipts, proof of payment.
Buyer walk-through (within 48 hours prior to closing, contract section 11).
Closing at Fidelity Land Title; possession at closing. Verify wiring instructions BY PHONE with title company (wire-fraud warning, contract section 33).
